items.title: Hermes Desktop Theme Pack
items.summary: Browse and apply Hermes skins across the CLI, TUI, Desktop and web dashboard.
items.detail:
Cliff Wade's theme pack provides YAML skins and a Theme Switcher for Hermes Desktop and the web dashboard. Preview themes, search for a palette, switch between light and dark counterparts, and apply a skin across Hermes surfaces.

To use the skins, follow the repository's installation instructions and select one through Hermes Appearance settings or /skin. The full switcher requires both its backend plugin and its Desktop UI plugin. With an SSH connection, install the backend on the remote host and the UI on the local Desktop computer; restart or reconnect the backend to mount its routes.

The author's accessibility and contrast claims have not been independently tested by this archive. Community theme credits are listed upstream, including BeardedChop/hermes-skins-pack. This listing is a documentation review, not a security audit or runtime endorsement.
cardPoints: Preview and apply skins across Hermes surfaces.
Browse themes from Desktop or the web dashboard.
items.author: Cliff Wade

items.title: Hermes Command Center
items.summary: Inspect Hermes health, activity, scheduled jobs, model usage, skills and memory from a Desktop dashboard.
items.detail:
Cliff Wade describes a read-only dashboard using local Hermes state to show processes, model usage, cron jobs, plugins, skills and memory. Its Desktop page uses /hermes-center so it can coexist with the host's built-in Command Center.

Follow the repository's instructions to install and enable the backend plugin, then install the Desktop UI plugin. Restart the backend so its API routes are mounted, reload Desktop plugins and open Hermes Center from the sidebar.

Requires Hermes Desktop and its plugin SDK. The author's read-only and no-telemetry claims have not been independently audited. No candidate code was installed or executed during archive review.
cardPoints: Inspect scheduled jobs, activity and model usage.
View local Hermes health, skills and memory.
items.author: Cliff Wade

items.title: Hermes Desktop Achievements
items.summary: View achievements, progress and goals in Hermes Desktop, with optional unlock notifications and share cards.
items.detail:
Originally created by Tony Simons and extended by Cliff Wade, this Desktop plugin displays badges, goals, records, rewards and custom achievements using the existing hermes-achievements backend through the Hermes plugin SDK.

Enable the hermes-achievements backend, install the Desktop UI plugin following the repository instructions, then reload Desktop plugins and open Achievements. The author recommends Hermes Desktop v0.19 or newer. The matching backend must be available and enabled.

Optional Discord announcements send unlock information to a configured webhook; leave them disabled unless you want that information shared. The archive reviewed documentation only and did not install or execute the plugin. Original-author credit is preserved from the repository's License section.
cardPoints: View badges, goals and progress in Desktop.
Choose unlock notifications and export share cards.
